title: Police disperse high-school students on a hill in Port Moresby

title: Sumgilbar campaign letters, mining-license withdrawal, and earlier hearings/forum
reason: The February actions described are letters seeking legal advice/additional Warden hearings and a mining-license withdrawal, not public gatherings. The dated hearings and Tokain village forum occurred in 2020, outside this month.
notes: The reports establish campaign activity and an administrative company-license outcome but no February public gathering or continuous physical action. The under-300 attendance figure applies to two September 2020 hearings combined and cannot establish turnout per hearing or in February.
